title: ConKay bolt-joint input contract
description: Every Bolt, Plate, Joint, and LoadCase field consumed by any current or planned bolted-joint limit state solver. The compiler enforces unit conversion for length/force/stress/area fields and validates constraints. The verdict guard reads this to surface missing/blocked checks.

Joint.props.kind.description: Joint design kind. Determines the required limit-state set per AISC 360-16 scope.

Joint.props.shearPlanes.description: Number of shear planes per bolt (1 = single shear, 2 = double shear).

Joint.props.threadsExcluded.description: Whether the threads are excluded from the shear plane (X vs N in AISC Table J3.2). Affects Fnv ratio (0.563 vs 0.450).

Joint.props.edgeDistance.description: Distance from the hole center to the plate edge, parallel to the applied load (AISC §J3.10c, L_e).

Joint.props.holePattern.applies_to: bearing joints with multiple bolts (required for J4-3 block-shear, §D2 net-section, bolt-group distribution)
Joint.props.holePattern.description: Per-bolt (per-hole) coordinates in the joint's local frame. The x axis is parallel to the applied load; y is perpendicular. Each entry is a positive length pair. The array length is the solver's responsibility to match against the Bolt children.

Joint.props.holeDiameter.description: Nominal hole diameter. Per AISC §J3.3: standard = d_bolt + 1/16" (1.6 mm), oversized = d_bolt + 1/8" (3.2 mm), slotted = slot width.

Joint.props.edgeDistancePerpendicular.description: Distance from the hole center to the plate edge, perpendicular to the applied load. Required for the L_e component of block-shear rupture paths.

Joint.props.spacing.description: Center-to-center spacing between adjacent bolts in the load direction. Required for block-shear path geometry and net-section deductions.

Joint.props.holeCountLoadDirection.description: Number of bolt holes in the failure path in the load direction (block-shear) or the cross-section (net-section).

Joint.props.fayingSurface.description: Faying-surface class per AISC SC connections. Class A = μ=0.30, B = μ=0.50, C = μ=0.35. Affects slip resistance.

Joint.props.holeType.description: Hole type per AISC §J3.3. Affects slip resistance (long-slotted reduces capacity).

Joint.props.boltPretension.description: Minimum specified bolt pretension per AISC §J3.8 (slip-critical) or as-applied (tension/prying). Defaults to 0.70·Fu·Ab for A325/A490.

Joint.props.boltCoordinates.description: Per-bolt coordinates in the joint's local frame, relative to the centroid. Required when the load is eccentric and equal-share is wrong.

Joint.props.loadVector.description: Applied load vector in the joint's local frame. Required for elastic bolt-group distribution (e.g. instant center method for in-plane shear).

Joint.props.eccentricity.description: Eccentricity of the applied load from the bolt group centroid. For in-plane shear and torsion, this is what generates the moment that the bolt group resists.

Joint.props.flangeThickness.description: T-stub flange thickness (one of two plies on either side of the bolt). Required for AISC §9 prying-action calculation (T-stub model).

Joint.props.plateGrossWidth.description: Plate gross width. For net-section: Ag = width × t. For gross-section: An = Ag - Σ(d_h × t) × U (shear lag factor).

Joint.props.shearLagFactor.description: Shear lag factor U from AISC Table D3.1 Case 2 (default 0.85 for flat plates with bolted connection at end). Depends on connection geometry.

Joint.props.environment.description: Service environment. Affects corrosion loss rate and atmospheric fatigue category per AISC Appendix 3.

Joint.props.fatigueCategory.description: AISC fatigue category for the detail. Determines the S-N curve (allowable stress range vs cycles). Per AISC Appendix 3 Table A-3.1.

Joint.props.fatigueCycles.description: Design number of stress-range cycles (e.g. 2,000,000 for bridges, 500,000 to 2,000,000 for cranes).

Joint.props.fatigueStressRange.description: Effective stress range (ΔF). For tension-only or reversal, may need separate ranges. The fatigue check is ΔF ≤ FSR·(allowable range at N cycles).

Bolt.props.grade.description: Bolt material grade. Currently derived from the Bolt.material; the grade enum is implicit. A separate field is planned for clarity.

Bolt.geometry.stressArea.description: Tensile stress area of the bolt (smaller than the nominal shank area; accounts for threads). Defaults to the value from the Bolt's grade table if not provided.

Bolt.geometry.length.description: Bolt length (grip + head + nut + washer stack).

Bolt.props.qty.description: Number of bolts at this position. Demand is divided by qty for per-bolt checks. Mass/cost solvers use qty directly.
Bolt.props.qty.status: existing (irregular; sometimes implied by edge count)

Plate.geometry.length.description: Plate length (parallel to load). For block-shear rupture path geometry.

Plate.geometry.width.description: Plate width (perpendicular to load). For net-section rupture: An = (width − Σd_h) × t × U.

Plate.material.ultimatePa.description: Plate ultimate tensile strength Fu (used in J3-6a, J3-6c, §D2, etc.).

Plate.material.yieldPa.description: Plate yield strength Fy (used in §D2-1 gross-section yielding, prying T-stub model).

LoadCase.loads[].target.description: The node the load is applied to (typically a Joint id).

LoadCase.loads[].shear.description: Factored shear load on the joint.

LoadCase.loads[].tension.description: Factured tension load on the joint.

LoadCase.loads[].axial.description: Alias for tension. Treated as tension by the verdict guard when present.

LoadCase.loads[].moment.description: Factored moment on the joint. For in-plane shear + torsion, the moment drives the elastic bolt distribution.

validation_error_codes.IRR_MISSING: Required field is absent; solver returns notComputed.
validation_error_codes.IRR_OUT_OF_RANGE: Value is below or above the allowed range.
validation_error_codes.IRR_GEOMETRY: Two fields together violate a geometric constraint (e.g. edgeDistance <= holeDiameter/2).
validation_error_codes.IRR_UNIT: Unit string is unrecognized or conflicts with the field's dimension.
validation_error_codes.IRR_TYPE: Value is the wrong type (e.g. string where number expected).

from_versions.v0: All pre-tearout designs. Joint.props.edgeDistance, Joint.props.holeDiameter, and Joint.props.kind are absent. Joint defaults to kind=bearing. Tear-out solver returns notComputed; verdict guard reports joint INCOMPLETE.

migration.to_v1: Add Joint.props.edgeDistance, Joint.props.holeDiameter, and (optionally) Joint.props.kind = 'bearing'. Existing fields unchanged. No automatic migration is attempted; absent fields stay absent.
